# reef

> A shared, living memory for a group of people and the AI assistants they
> talk to. Each circle of your life gets a cove: a small wiki your assistant
> reads before it answers, and writes back to as things change.

reef is built by Haai BV and runs at https://reefwith.me. It speaks the Model
Context Protocol, so Claude, ChatGPT and Codex can all connect to the same
memory, and there is a command-line client and a matching agent skill for
terminal-first setups.

What makes it different from an assistant's built-in memory:

- **Shared, not personal.** A cove belongs to a household, a project or a
  team, so everyone's assistant starts from the same picture.
- **A wiki, not a blob.** Memory is pages a person can read, correct and
  reorganise, not an opaque store you have to trust.
- **Map before memory.** An assistant loads an index of what exists first,
  then fetches only the pages the conversation actually needs.
- **Yours to leave with.** Everything exports, and deleting means deleted.

reef is invitation-only: there is no public sign-up, and people arrive because
someone already inside adds them to a cove.

## Pages

- [Home](https://reefwith.me/): what reef is, how coves work, and how to
  connect Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or the CLI to it.
- [What's new](https://reefwith.me/changelog): release notes, newest first.
- [Privacy](https://reefwith.me/privacy): what is stored, where it lives, who
  can see it, and how to get it back or delete it.
- [Terms](https://reefwith.me/terms): the agreement between a user and Haai BV.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint: https://reefwith.me/mcp
- Source: https://github.com/diepzee/rif
- CLI: `uv tool install reef-cli` (Python) or `npm install -g @haai/reef-cli`
